camel_example: aliyun iot ListOTAJobByDevice --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 10 --CurrentPage 1 --FirmwareId FJFx8JzpnhpIsKftRjjm030000 --ProductKey a19mzPZ0000 --DeviceName light1
description_en: Retrieves the list of OTA update batches in which a specified device is included
description_zh: 调用该接口获取设备所在的升级包升级批次列表
kebab_example: aliyun iot list-ota-job-by-device --firmware-id FJFx8JzpnhpIsKftRjjm030000 --page-size 10 --product-key a19mzPZ0000 --device-name light1 --current-page 1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListOTAJobByDevice

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this ID value exists, you must specify it. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or the </ph></props>ID value does not exist, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the update package. This is the unique identifier of the update package.

The FirmwareId is one of the parameters returned when you call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147311.html to create an update package. You can also call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147450.html to view the ID from the response parameters
parameters.help_zh:
升级包ID。升级包的唯一标识符。

升级包ID是调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147311.html创建升级包时，返回的参数之一。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147450.html，从返回参数中查看
parameters.name: firmware_id

parameters.help_en: The number of update packages to display per page in the response. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的升级包数量。最大限制为100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en: The page number to return. Page numbers start from 1
parameters.help_zh: 显示返回结果的第几页。返回结果页数从1开始排序
parameters.name: current_page

Code.description_en: The error code returned if the call fails. For more information, see [Error codes]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）
Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码。更多信息，请参见[错误码]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87387.html）

SimpleOTAJobInfo.description_en: The update batch information returned if the call was successful. For more information, see SimpleOTAJobInfo below
SimpleOTAJobInfo.description_zh: 调用成功时，返回的升级批次信息。详情请参见以下SimpleOTAJobInfo

FirmwareId.description_en: The ID of the update package

JobId.description_en: The ID of the update batch

JobStatus.description_en:
The status of the update batch.

IN_PROGRESS: In progress.

COMPLETED: Completed.

CANCELED: Canceled
JobStatus.description_zh:
升级任务批次的状态。

IN_PROGRESS：执行中。

COMPLETED：已完成。

CANCELED：已取消

JobType.description_en:
The batch type.

VERIFY_FIRMWARE: Update package verification batch.

UPGRADE_FIRMWARE: Batch update batch
JobType.description_zh:
批次类型。

VERIFY_FIRMWARE：升级包验证批次。

UPGRADE_FIRMWARE：批量升级批次

ProductKey.description_en: The unique identifier of the product to which the update package belongs
ProductKey.description_zh: 升级包所属产品的唯一标识

SelectionType.description_en:
The update policy.

DYNAMIC: Dynamic update. This value is returned for update batches created by calling [CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html）.

STATIC: Static update. This value is returned for update batches created by calling [CreateOTAStaticUpgradeJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html）
SelectionType.description_zh:
升级策略。

DYNAMIC：动态升级。调用[CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html）创建的升级批次，该参数返回该值。

STATIC：静态升级。调用[CreateOTAStaticUpgradeJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html）创建的升级批次，该参数返回该值

TargetSelection.description_en:
The update scope.

ALL: Full update.

SPECIFIC: Targeted update.

GRAY: Canary update.

For dynamic update batches created by calling [CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html）, only ALL is returned for this parameter
TargetSelection.description_zh:
升级范围。

ALL：全量升级。

SPECIFIC：定向升级。

GRAY：灰度升级。

调用[CreateOTADynamicUpgradeJob]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html）创建的动态升级批次，该参数仅返回ALL

UtcCreate.description_en: The time when the batch was created, in UTC format
UtcCreate.description_zh: 批次创建时的时间，UTC格式

UtcEndTime.description_en:
The time when the batch finished, in UTC format.

This parameter is returned only for completed update batches
UtcEndTime.description_zh:
该批次任务执行结束时的时间，UTC格式。

仅已执行结束的升级批次才返回此参数

UtcModified.description_en: The time when the batch was last modified, in UTC format
UtcModified.description_zh: 批次最后一次修改时的时间，UTC格式

UtcStartTime.description_en: The time when the batch started, in UTC format
UtcStartTime.description_zh: 该批次任务开始执行时的时间，UTC格式

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned if the call fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息
ErrorMessage.example: FirmwareId is mandatory for this action

PageSize.description_en: The number of update packages displayed per page
PageSize.description_zh: 每页显示的升级包数量

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request
RequestId.description_zh: 阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call was successful.
true: The call was successful.
false: The call failed
Success.description_zh:
是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
false：调用失败

Total.description_en: The total number of update packages
